title: Align homepage read-more links and About Me section with Figma
context: The homepage root page at `/` should better match the existing Figma desktop and mobile frames. Figma sources: desktop https://www.figma.com/design/0J2JF0nYrI8EJrttdHNes4/Portfolio?node-id=1-549&t=AL7MiQ7CLvTxT4Cf-0 and mobile https://www.figma.com/design/0J2JF0nYrI8EJrttdHNes4/Portfolio?node-id=79-219&t=AL7MiQ7CLvTxT4Cf-0. Desktop should match closely, mobile should match the mobile frame, and tablet should scale from mobile using Figma auto-layout as a guide. This plan covers mid-page link affordances and the About Me section layout, imagery, copy, and skill cards.

tasks.title: Resize read-more arrows and align mobile view-all links
acceptance_criteria: Read-more arrow icons render at the size shown in the Figma frames
The insights `View all` link is centered on mobile
The case studies `View all` link is centered on mobile
Mobile spacing around both `View all` links matches the Figma mobile frame
Desktop spacing and alignment for the links remains consistent with the Figma desktop frame
`npm run verify` passes after the change

tasks.title: Rework About Me image, paragraph, and mobile layout
acceptance_criteria: The About Me main image no longer has a linear gradient overlay applied over the image itself
A separate blurred gradient element is positioned and sized around the paragraph content to match the Figma blurred element
The About Me content renders as a single paragraph
The portrait frame has the slanted appearance from Figma while the portrait image itself remains visually unwarped
On mobile, the portrait and About Me headline are centered
On mobile, the portrait size is reduced to match the Figma mobile frame more closely
`npm run verify` passes after the change

tasks.title: Restyle About Me skill cards to match Figma
acceptance_criteria: Skill cards have no border radius
Each skill card uses a left border that matches that skill's color
Skill cards match the paragraph width at applicable desktop and tablet sizes
Skill cards render at equal height regardless of copy differences
The skill-card layout remains readable and non-overlapping on mobile
`npm run verify` passes after the change
